app.name: Supplier Carbon
app.tagline: Forward the email. Photograph the bills. Get back the completed questionnaire.

signIn.title: Sign in with your phone.
signIn.lede: We text you a six-digit code. No password, no account to create, nothing else stored about you.
signIn.emailLabel: Or sign in with an email link
signIn.linkSent: Check your email and open the link on this device.
signIn.error: That did not work. Check the number and try again.
signIn.devHint: Local emulator: any number works and the code is printed in the emulator log.
signIn.eyebrow: For suppliers asked for carbon data

points.p1: Your bills stay yours: only you can read your account.
points.p2: Works on a phone camera; no scanner or spreadsheet needed.
points.p3: Available in Vietnamese, Japanese and English.

signIn.smsNote: Standard SMS rates may apply. Used only to sign you in.
signIn.wrongCode: That code did not match. Try again or request a new one.

setup.title: About your company
setup.lede: Three things decide how your figures are calculated: where you are, which year your customer asked for, and which sites count.
setup.name: Company name
setup.startOverLede: Delete every bill, answer and result for this account. Your company details stay.
setup.startOverConfirm: Delete all bills, answers and results? Your company details will be kept.
setup.languageHint: The questions on the next steps are asked in this language.
setup.sitesHint: One row per factory or office whose bills you will upload.
setup.startedOver: All bills, answers and results removed.

documents.title: Your bills
documents.lede: Electricity bills, fuel invoices, LPG deliveries, refrigerant service slips. Photos or PDFs, any order, any language.
documents.dropBody: Photos or PDFs. You can review the list before anything is uploaded.
documents.onlyImagesPdf: Only images and PDFs can be read. Other files were skipped.
documents.uploadingHint: Each bill is read by the model as it arrives. Keep this page open.
documents.emptyBody: Start with an electricity bill. Any language, any order; we sort them out.
documents.emptyHint: The model found no energy quantity in this file. Is it a bill?
documents.removeBody: {name} and the data read from it will be deleted. Your figures will be recalculated the next time you check your bills.
documents.summaryFoot: Solid = read from a bill. Dashed = no bill covers that month yet; we will ask about it on the next step. Diesel and refrigerant are deliveries, not monthly bills, so they have no strip.
documents.needMore: Add at least one bill to continue.

reconcile.title: A few questions
reconcile.lede: We compared your bills against the reporting year. Anything missing or unclear, we ask you here.
reconcile.resetConfirm: Clear the conversation, your answers and the calculated figures? Your bills are kept, so you can answer differently.
reconcile.resetDone: Questions reset. Your bills are kept.
reconcile.startHint: We compare the bills against your reporting year, drop duplicates, cut periods to the year and look for months with nothing. Anything the checks cannot settle, we ask you.
reconcile.startNoDocs: Upload at least one bill first.
reconcile.systemCard: Checked {docs} bill(s) · {n} thing(s) to ask you

note.apportioned: {n} bill(s) straddling the year apportioned by days
note.outsideFy: {n} record(s) outside the reporting year ignored

issue.unitHours: {energy} recorded in running hours; litres per hour needed
issue.lowConfidence: A {energy} value was hard to read; please confirm

inventory.title: Your inventory
inventory.lede: Every number traces back to a bill, a published emission factor and, where you told us something, the assumption we recorded.
inventory.notComputedBody: Finish the questions first, or calculate now from the bills as they are.

tierWhy.primary: Quantity read from an invoice or meter reading
tierWhy.secondary: Corrected by you or converted from another unit
tierWhy.estimated: Filled from your answer to a question

factorCard.nearestYear: The {year} factor is the nearest published vintage for your reporting year.
factorCard.nationalFallback: National factor used; no sub-national factor exists for this site.
factorCard.marketFallback: No residual-mix or contract factor is published here, so the market-based figure uses the grid average (GHG Protocol Scope 2 hierarchy).

method.title: How these figures were calculated
method.lede: {n} published factor(s), {a} assumption(s). Tap to read the method.
method.scope2Value: Reported both location-based (headline) and market-based, per the Scope 2 Guidance dual-reporting requirement.

inventory.noAssumptions: No assumptions touch this line. It is a straight read from the bill.
inventory.correctBody: {from} {unit} becomes {to} {unit}. The line is marked as corrected by you and every total is recalculated.

questionnaire.title: Your customer's questionnaire
questionnaire.lede: Upload the Excel your customer sent. We fill every cell we can from your inventory and flag the rest.
questionnaire.share: Share of your output this customer buys (optional, for allocation)
questionnaire.lockedHint: From your bills — correct the quantity in the inventory
questionnaire.addRevenue: Add revenue in Setup to calculate this
questionnaire.dropBody: Drop the .xlsx here or choose it. We keep the layout and write into the answer column.
questionnaire.legend: Green cells come from your bills and the calculator. Blue cells you typed. Yellow cells are for you to complete; the reason is written beside them.
questionnaire.emptyBody: Upload the Excel your customer sent. Try data/templates/cdp_sme_questionnaire.xlsx for the CDP SME climate module.

landing.eyebrow: For suppliers asked for carbon data
landing.sub: Your customer sent an emissions questionnaire. Upload your electricity, fuel and refrigerant bills; we read them, ask only what the bills cannot tell us, and hand back a Scope 1 and 2 inventory with every number traced to a document and a published factor.
landing.ctaSub: No account to create. Works on a phone. Vietnamese, Japanese, English.

mock.s2b: 42,569 kWh, as printed on the bill
mock.s3b: 0.6592 kgCO2e/kWh — MONRE Vietnam grid factor, 2025 vintage

bills.title: Bills
bills.body: Photograph or upload electricity bills, fuel invoices, LPG deliveries and refrigerant slips. Any language, any order.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: We drop duplicates, cut periods to your reporting year and find the months with nothing. Then we ask you, one question at a time.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.body: Scope 1 and 2 by month, site and fuel. Every line opens into the bill, the factor with its source, and the arithmetic.

questionnaire.title: Questionnaire
questionnaire.body: Upload your customer's Excel. We fill what the inventory can answer, flag what only you can, and give you the file back.

landing.trustBody: Carbon numbers get audited. So every figure here can be opened, followed back to its source and, where we had to assume something, read in your own words.

factors.title: Published factors, cited
factors.body: National grid factors, IPCC and DEFRA values, each with its source, vintage and link.

lineage.title: Every number has a trail
lineage.body: Document → quantity → factor → result. Rendered on screen and in the methodology PDF.

honest.title: Honest about gaps
honest.body: Cells we cannot answer are flagged for you, never guessed. Estimated months are marked as such.

outputs.title: Files your buyer accepts
outputs.body: The filled workbook, colour-coded by source, and an auditor-readable methodology note.

landing.finalTitle: Your bills already hold the answer.
landing.finalBody: Sign in with your phone and upload the first one.
landing.footerNote: Demo build. Bills shown are synthetic; emission factors are real and cited.
